records.observation: Copies buffer bounds; creates two HashMaps line-group nestable/nestless, row mapsnull, drawing flags true, height factors default0 until initialize. Merge methods key by List[category topology,startLineID,finalLineID], create TimeAveBox(buffer,true/false), dispatch Shadow vs real. No topology enforcement, category visibility/overlap filtering, sorting or post-finalization guard. setNestingExclusion loops original nestable boxes and calls their one-shot exclusion; repeat unguarded. toString traverses both line maps unsorted with topology/endpoints and box summaries. getLine2RowMappedKey preserves topology and looks up both integer line IDs in supplied Map; null/missing/wrong-type row values unvalidated. initializeDrawing REPLACES row maps each call, copies/merges all line boxes by mapped row key (multiple line pairs aggregate), then for nestable ROW copies calls exclusion, initializes category array, and sets SummaryState times. For nestless ROW copies initializes array then SummaryArrow times, no exclusion. Boolean selects zero-to-duration or original absolute bounds. Thus ordinary repeated initialize uses fresh row boxes and avoids stale arrays/second-exclusion on same row instance; original line-box exclusion remains separately caller-triggered, not automatically performed before copy. Copied nestable rows contain source boxes as timeblocks and no original real list, so source exclusive ratios must already be prepared by caller. No category filtering in remap; missing keys can merge unrelated groups under null then fail Integer.intValue during drawing. Sets global SummaryState background and stores height factors without validation. drawStates false/drawArrows false returns0 before null-map access; otherwise drawing before initialize fails. States use start row only, vertical band row+-initialHeight/2 and margin(initial-next)/2; final row remains key distinction but unused in state geometry. Arrows use both rows. Both loops HashMap order, sum attempted draw counts, do not select by topology beyond which merge map caller used. getSummarizableAt checks arrows FIRST if enabled, first HashMap-order hit wins, wraps whole TimeAveBox with topology and two rows. Then states first hit wraps CategoryTimeBox or TimeAveBox and duplicates start row into both result endpoints. No global z-order/reverse-paint/nearest-hit resolution across groups, no category filtering; SummaryState/SummaryArrow helpers handle inner tests. No original runtime execution; this reading narrows earlier cache/repeat risks to paths outside the fresh initialization sequence rather than asserting normal UI failure.
